title: Legacy system modernization: why 71% go over budget
takeaways: 71% of firms exceeded their original modernization budget (Ensono 2026)
61% paused, delayed, scaled back or abandoned a programme (Ensono)
Core app modernization is 25% of Indian IT capex (Bain 2026)
About 70% of Indian leaders say legacy tech debt will take time (Bain)
